name: CodeTracer
abstract: CodeTracer evaluates process-level tracing and localization for coding agents. This page uses the Overall F1 of the CodeTracer configuration from the main table.
method: This work focuses on a question beyond final success: whether an agent can accurately trace intermediate states and localize the source of failure.
It introduces CodeTraceBench and reports step-level precision, recall, and F1 for process-aware localization.
The main results show substantial F1 gains when the CodeTracer framework is added to different backbones.

metrics.name: Overall F1
metrics.note: Overall step-level F1 of the CodeTracer configuration.
